lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill region. A primary column contains approximately five large, equidistant maxima, followed by subsequent vertical columns that form a non-uniform grid extending toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs. These bands are most prominent in the mid-flank region, where the blobs serve as nodes within the vertical stripe structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to localized shadow on the ventral edge.
